heading: INT. CLOSED FUNICULAR STATION - WAITING ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CLOSED FUNICULAR STATION - WAITING ROOM - NIGHT
Wooden benches, a dead ticket window, a brass clock stopped at ten past four.
Rain ticks on a skylight.
AGNES PRUITT (60s, retired schoolteacher, buttoned to the chin) pours tea from a flask into four paper cups.
DELROY CAMPBELL (40s, line mechanic in a grease-stained parka) sits on the bench by the door.
WEI-LING CHOU (30s, insurance investigator, wet umbrella across her knees) studies the clock.
FATHER TOBIAS (70s, rumpled cardigan under a black coat) leans on the ticket window, humming.
Sugar, anyone?
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Just the tea.
units.name: DELROY

units.text: Who owns this station now, Mr. Campbell?
units.name: WEI-LING

units.text: The company. Nobody comes up here but me.
units.name: DELROY

units.text: And us. A fine thing, the four of us in a snowglobe.
units.name: FATHER TOBIAS

units.text: It's rain, Father.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Then a rain globe.
units.name: FATHER TOBIAS

units.text: Wei-Ling accepts a cup, sips, and smiles for the first time.
It's good tea.
units.name: WEI-LING

units.text: I know.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Wei-Ling lowers the cup.
Her eyes go to the ticket window.
A faint metal glint sits behind the grille.
Mr. Campbell. Is that the cash box?
units.name: WEI-LING

units.text: Delroy and Father Tobias both look at the window.
Nobody speaks.
Delroy stands.
It was empty when I locked it.
units.name: DELROY

units.text: Was it?
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Delroy lunges for the window.
Father Tobias steps in front of him, and the two grapple against the counter, the old priest surprisingly strong.
Wei-Ling drops the umbrella and tries to pull them apart.
Agnes sets down the flask, calmly, and the three of them freeze as she opens her coat to show a revolver tucked in her belt.
The tea was only for waiting.
units.name: AGNES

units.text: Wei-Ling's cup slips from her hand.
Delroy slumps onto the bench.
The clock, for no reason at all, ticks forward one minute.
